}}'''Zenare Ghodar''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zenare Ghodar}}

==Appearance==
She is plump and haughty.

== Strength ==
Zenare is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|25}}. 

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].

She was not present when [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] [[Heal]]ed both [[Leane Sharif]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] from [[stilling]] and insisted on her going through the whole process again step by step and even tries to give advice on how to improve it.
